test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **"Sieze."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is **"Seize."**
 
• The letter **"i"** comes after **"e"** in this word.
 
• **"Seize" **means to take hold of something suddenly and firmly; to grab something. (किसी वस्‍तु को एकाएक और कसकर पकड़ लेना; छीन लेना, झपट लेना)
 
 
• Example: *The thief seized her handbag and ran off with it.*
 
 
 
• Other examples of words with the "ie" spelling include **"believe"** and **"relieve".**
 
• The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Erase: (मिटाना)** **-** To remove written or printed material.
 
• **Dredge: (खोदना) - **To clear out by scooping or digging.
 
• **North: (उत्तर) -** Direction opposite to south; up on maps.
